blocks.text: (The Person Whom I Respect the Most)
I have read about many interesting people in history books.
I admire and respect some of those people who appear in them.
The person I respect the most is General Soon-Shin Lee.
and he defeated the Japanese in battle many times.
He lived during a difficult time of Korean history,
but he always thought of Korea and Koreans before himself.
I respect him because he was able to prepare
and carry out great triumphs over his enemies.
He always was confident that they would be successful
